headline: Compliance Manager
summary: Compliance manager with ten years in banking, mining supply and government contracting in Northern Mindanao. I build compliance programs, review contracts and procurement against the law, and advise management on legal and regulatory risk. I lead a team of four and report compliance and risk to the board.
highlights: Built the compliance program of a cooperative bank that passed its regulator examination without major findings.
Set up contract review for all supply contracts, cutting disputes with suppliers by half.
Led the company's first data privacy compliance program under the Data Privacy Act.
